create_libdevice_find: create a triton-version-friendly way to import CUDA math functions like rsqrt from libdevice modules
run_libdevice_find: run libdevice_find to retrieve a symbol such as rsqrt from the first available triton libdevice module
test_libdevice_find: test libdevice_find with various triton module paths to verify it finds and returns the requested symbol
refactor_libdevice_find: refactor libdevice_find to support additional triton libdevice module locations or fallback strategies
review_libdevice_find: review libdevice_find for robustness when triton module structure changes across versions
